posts.text: Polite pushback on Tapper question framed as there being "a" reason this is a story. I believe that Jake believed it the moment he asked it - based on his reporting. I think that is an over simplified, binary framing -- that is not the way the world works. Truth isn't black and white. Truth is symphonic
posts.summary: Critiques binary framing in journalism; argues truth is complex
